one_month_reasoning: No scheduled company event before 2026-12-24 (Q4 FY27 print is late Feb/early Mar 2027). In the window: post-print analyst target cuts and FY28 estimate cuts (Zacks feed still pre-print: FY28 EPS 20.11 vs our ~18.5), which typically extend a guide-down drift; December tax-loss selling in a stock down ~68% from its high; against that, an active buyback ($200M authorization, $100M spent in Q3) and short-term reversal after a -19% print day. Net: a slight negative tilt, median ~$178, symmetric log spread at monthly vol 59%/3.5 = 16.9%.

downside.story: P10: FTTH customers cut deeper once FY28 budgets are final and overbuilder distress spreads (more bad-debt charges), BEAD slips to FY29+, comms revenue ~-3% in FY28 and margin ~10.9%; a Loudoun/DMV moratorium or hyperscaler pause trims BS margin; the stock re-rates to ~8x P/E as in fiber-cycle troughs, and supplier-finance/DSO concerns keep the credit discount. The supplier-finance program being pulled (all 524.0 debt-like) is a further ~-$9/share inside this tail.

base.story: FY28 is a digestion year: comms +3% (FTTH down, long-haul/DCI and copper up, BEAD late), comms margin 12.4% (expands only 20bp on FY27), Building Systems +18% at ~21% margin; FY28 EPS ~$19 at a 26% tax (about 4-5% under the pre-print Zacks $20.11), recovery in FY29. The market keeps most of today's discount (10.8x P/E).

upside.story: P90: long-haul/DCI backlog converts fast and FTTH plans firm up, comms grows ~+8% (the backlog-conversion read), margin back to 13%, BS runs at 'or better' growth, and the multiple recovers toward the peer median (~14x).

reasoning: Round 2 (skeptic lane). Supervisor findings adopted: (1) supplier finance is not all debt: the 10-Q shows no interest and unchanged supplier terms, so only the payable stretch beyond the pre-program 18.4 days (29.6 days now, AP checked in SEC XBRL) is debt-like, 252.9 not 524.0 (+$9/share); (2) the CEO said Communications margin expands y/y in FY28, so FY28 moves from 12.0% to 12.4% (still only +20bp, below the supervisor set's 12.9%, because fuel reprices at renewal, crews are kept while FTTH shrinks and overbuilder bad debt recurs: $22.7M reserve in Q3); FY29 12.7%; (3) tax on the adjusted-EPS basis is the company-stated 26.0% non-GAAP rate, not GAAP history (24.5%). Net: base 219.49 -> 229.38. Kept: Comms FY28 +3% (below the CEO's mid-single digit; FTTH guided down and MTZ-type carrier pullbacks), Building Systems +18% labor-capped at a 21% margin, exit 10.8x on peers repriced at the same date as DY. Post-print consensus is not out yet (feeds still pre-print 2026-11-25). Follow-up searches for post-print downgrades returned only stale 2023-2025 notes (Wells Fargo 2023, B. Riley 2023, KeyBanc 2025), so research was limited and they move nothing. Earlier round-1 evidence stands: Q3 beat but FTTH cut guided for FY28, two customer defaults, OCF $14.1M with DSO 112, Ba2 credit. Range: downside $125.5 (deeper FTTH cuts, comms ~-3% and ~10.9% margin, BS margin -2pt, ~8.3x), upside $354 (backlog conversion, comms ~+8%, re-rate toward peers). Left tail fatter than right.
